results.title: Session cards roll into a summary, using actual module coordination
results.scope: Deterministic injected summarizer supplies text; no LLM semantics or factual accuracy measured.

results.title: Protected categories and importance survive ordinary entry pressure
results.scope: Protects storage retention only, not guaranteed future recall or truth.

results.title: Entry structure survives a fresh VM reading identical synthetic storage

output.summary: 用户近期玩星露谷物语

results.scope: Synthetic localStorage reload, not fresh operating-system process or real IndexedDB acceptance.

results.title: Disabled automatic ingestion leaves no new pending text
results.scope: Tests this module automatic ingestion/prompt gate, not the application permission system.

results.title: Exact ISO date and keyword outrank a more important unrelated entry
results.scope: Deterministic literal matching; no embedding or natural-language date interpretation.

results.title: Retired facts cannot enter the active entry selection
results.scope: Status filtering works; the module still cannot reliably infer or commit retirement from a correction.

results.title: Prompt includes at most 12 already-normalized entries as complete strings
results.scope: Complete canonical stored strings only. It does NOT prove original input was not truncated or an overall token budget is safe.

results.title: Existing session cards can be updated and removed with IDs
results.scope: Card management, not automatic long-term fact correction, source deletion or deletion barrier.

results.title: Consolidation deletes dialogue added while the old request is in flight
results.conclusion: Raw consolidation cannot be adopted; batch identity and atomic confirmation are missing.

results.title: Protected entries can exceed the nominal entry cap and are not all recalled
results.conclusion: Protection is retention policy, not bounded capacity or a guarantee every important memory is recalled.

results.title: Entry normalization truncates original summaries at 120 characters
results.conclusion: Withdraw claim that Ryza supplies safe complete-original-entry budgeting; retain only selector leaf and reject raw normalizer.

results.title: Consolidation cuts a large JSON body into invalid JSON at 12000 characters
results.conclusion: Aimy must pack whole validated records before serialization; slicing JSON is not reusable budgeting.

results.title: Literal retrieval does not match a synonymous phrase
results.conclusion: Only a lexical baseline; no claim of Chinese semantic recall improvement.

results.title: A correction with a different text prefix creates two active facts
results.conclusion: Text-prefix dedup is not reliable correction; stable fact keys and versions must come from Aimy.

results.title: Card update reports true while storage rejects the write
results.conclusion: Do not reuse raw mutation success contract; UI must wait for a durable write receipt.

results.title: Deleted entry is re-added by a late consolidation response
results.conclusion: Management UI is a functional gap, but reliable forgetting is not implemented in this source store.

results.title: A relative-date cue boosts every entry rather than selecting yesterday
results.conclusion: RECENT_CUE adds one to every entry. Only exact ISO date matches are tested as positive; no natural-language temporal retrieval claim.
